replies.text:
That message is not something we would send. Fibrapunto never asks you to update card details through a link in a text or email. This looks like a phishing attempt.

My advice:

- Do not click the link.
- Do not enter any card or bank details there.
- Delete the message.

If you would like to check your real billing status with us, I can do that. Just give me your contract number, in the format FP-YYYY-NNNNNN.

If you think your account or card may already be compromised, I can also connect you with a colleague.
